mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Katarina is channeling her ultimate. Enemy champions stay in range at their peril!
Katarina's next spell or basic attack against this target will deal bonus magic damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Champion kills or assists reduce Katarina's cooldowns by 15 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Champion takedowns and assists reduce Katarina's cooldowns by 15 seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina instantly moves to her target's location and takes reduced damage from enemies for a few seconds. If the target is an enemy, she deals damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Moves to a target's location. Deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage if the target is an enemy.

After using {{Spell_KatarinaE_Jade_Name}}, Katarina takes @DamageReduction@% reduced damage for @DamageReductionDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina throws a dagger that bounces from enemy to enemy, dealing magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Throws a dagger dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage. The dagger bounces to the @MaxBounces@ closest enemies dealing 10% less damage with each bounce.

Enemies hit are marked for @MarkDuration@ seconds. Katarina's basic attacks or spells will consume the mark dealing @TotalDamageMark@ additional magic damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, throwing daggers with unrivaled speed at up to three nearby Champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Becomes a flurry of blades, throwing daggers at the closest 3 enemy Champions dealing <magicDamage>@DamageCalcTooltipOnly@ magic damage</magicDamage> over 2.5 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <keyword>Grievous Wounds</keyword>: Reduces the effectiveness of Healing and Regeneration effects.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina whirls her daggers around her, dealing magic damage to all enemies in the area. If she hits an enemy Champion, Katarina gains a burst of speed for a short duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Whirls daggers in a circle dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage. If she hits an enemy Champion, Katarina gains @Haste*100@%  <speed>Movement Speed</speed> for @BuffDuration@ second.
